fundamental.summary: KEY shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 17 days adds near-term risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market sentiment neutral across AAII and Fear & Greed; insufficient data for directional conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (286.4) combined with earnings binary in 17 days creates severe near-term risk for KEY despite normal yield curve.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical confluence (SMA golden cross, Ichimoku cross-up, price above major MAs, supertrend bullish) with tech_score of 7 provides structural bullish alignment for swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI9 overbought (89.53), weak ADX trend strength (11.81), VIX crisis regime (286.4), high earnings risk in 17 days, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create severe pullback and binary event risk that outweighs technical setup.
